title: Bits of a Boolean list
statement: Encode a finite Boolean list recursively by assigning the empty list the integer $0$ and assigning a list with first entry $b$ and remaining list $L$ the integer $2E(L)+b$, where $E$ denotes this encoding and Boolean values are identified with $0$ and $1$. For every list $L$ and index $i$, the binary digit in position $i$ of its encoding equals the entry at index $i$, taking the entry to be false when the index is outside the list.
